reference_findings.diagnosis: Suspected coronary perforation with possible tamponade physiology in a simulated cath-lab event.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: Severe procedural complication; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Sinus tachycardia with nonspecific ischemic changes; ECG alone does not establish the cause.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: CBC/hemoglobin trend and coagulation/antithrombotic context requested; immediate lab values may lag behind clinical deterioration.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: New pericardial effusion with features concerning for evolving tamponade in the synthetic event; requires urgent expert assessment.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Simulation log reports suspected contrast extravasation from a coronary branch; images are abstracted and not a procedural training guide.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: Before event: HR 76 bpm, BP 126/74 mmHg. Event: HR 112 bpm, BP 78/48 mmHg, SpO2 93%; immediate simulated deterioration.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.history_of_present_illness: The initial presentation is a stable coronary lesion case; this branch tests recognition of an acute procedural complication.

pathway_review.label: Pause the training sequence and trigger immediate cath-lab emergency response

reference_findings.safety_review: Hard stop, deterministic deterioration timeline, event logging, simulated team activation, echo reassessment and post-event debrief. Do not include device-specific sealing steps or procedural maneuvers.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: emergency response is activated; the simulator tracks time to recognition and escalation. The case does not teach the technical repair procedure.
learning_objectives: Recognize hypotension plus new effusion as an emergency pattern.
Record the event timeline and team response.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
